transcript_tail.text: Can you collect the status of the move to public for all the... for repos? I want to also... I I changed my mind how I wanna manage. I wanna manage it in the following way. I will have the archive repos with what I had before making the public. Like, what what were my repos before, all the cleanups or recreating the the the history without secrets, all all the sanitization. Then we will have one repo that will be the new private repo that is this sanitized version of the previous repos, and we will have one public version that I will only update once in a while after doing sanitization again because when we work on a daily basis that maybe misses on sanitization, so I wanna have a double pass before... or make things public. So I'll have one archive, one private, sanitized, and one public sanitized that is not updated all the time.

Here's where the go-public effort stands across the three repo families, and how the new 3-tier model maps onto today's state.

## Status by epic (source: GitHub Projects board #1)

| Family | Master tracker | State | Hard gates remaining |
|---|---|---|---|
| **FamilyFund** | `FamilyFund#36` | Open, closest to flip | `#20` rotate prod secrets · `#10` flip to public · `#11` post-flip CodeQL/SARIF |
| **dstrader** (Java) | `dstrader#1` | Open, mid-flight | A–F pre-prod (`#2–#8`) · prod cutover paired with `dstrader-aws#10/#11` · human-only flip `dstrader#10` |
| **dstrader-docker** | `dstrader-aws#18` | Open, earliest | SOPS prod cutover (`#10/#11`), spirit checkout swap (`#15`), de-hardcode compose (`#8`), prod age deploy (`#7`), IB least-priv (`#12`), then flip `#16` + post-flip `#17` |

`FamilyFund#33` (the older human-only-only epic) is already Done — superseded by `#36`.

## Mapping today's repos onto your new 3-tier model

| Family | (1) Archive | (2) Private sanitized — daily driver | (3) Public sanitized — periodic |
|---|---|---|---|
| **FamilyFund** | ✅ `FamilyFund-archive` (+ `FamilyFund-r1-interim`, slated to delete) | ✅ `FamilyFund` | ❌ **does not exist** — current plan flips the daily driver itself |
| **dstrader** | ⚠️ only local bundles in `~/dev/_repo-backups/2026-05-25-dstrader-prepurge2/` and `…-prepurge/` — **no GitHub `dstrader-archive`** | ✅ `dstrader` | ❌ does not exist |
| **dstrader-docker** | ⚠️ `dstrader-aws` is the de facto dirty origin, still live on spirit's cron — earmarked to archive *after* `#15/#16` per `dstrader-aws#18` cleanup section | ✅ `dstrader-docker` | ❌ does not exist |

Plus the always-private companions: `familyfund-secrets`, `dstrader-secrets` (SOPS+age twins + runbooks — never publish).

## What the strategy change implies

1. **The "flip the daily driver" tickets become wrong:** `FamilyFund#10`, `dstrader#10`, `dstrader-aws#16` all say `gh repo edit --visibility public` on the live repo. Under the new model they should be replaced with "create separate `*-public` repo + sync from sanitized private."
2. **New artifact needed:** a re-sanitization SOP for the periodic private → public sync (the "second pass" — gitleaks `--all` + the existing scrub-validation grep + a deliberate human review window).
3. **dstrader has no GitHub archive** — only local bundles. If you want symmetry with the FamilyFund pattern (and durability beyond this Mac), we'd push those bundles up to a private `dstrader-archive`.
4. **`dstrader-aws` is doing double duty** (archive + still-live-on-spirit-cron). The spirit-checkout swap (`dstrader-aws#15`) is the prerequisite to fully retiring it as an archive-only thing.
